author: UsersHammer
description: Playful mock-moderation for regular members. Users can banish, remove, silence, or chatmute others with typical moderator-style lines. Nothing is actually banned, kicked, muted, or timed out. Staff can edit per-command lines, change the disclaimer, DM targets, post a fake modlog, and toggle a 1-in-5 backfire chance. Command names default to banish/remove/silence/chatmute so they do not clash with Red's real ban, kick, mute, or timeout commands.
short: Playful fake ban/kick/mute/timeout responses for members.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store end user data. Guild staff may save custom joke response templates, command aliases, disclaimer text, and a fake modlog channel ID for the server. Those settings are not tied to a user ID. If DMs are enabled, the bot sends a one-off joke notice to the targeted user and does not store that message.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing UsersHammer.

This cog is **roleplay only**. It never bans, kicks, mutes, or times anyone out.
Disclaimer: This does not actually ban, kick, mute, or timeout users.

Default member commands:
`[p]banish`  `[p]remove`  `[p]silence`  `[p]chatmute`
Command list: `[p]uh`  (staff see setup commands too)

Staff: `[p]uhset text ban <line>`  `[p]uhset dm`  `[p]uhset disclaimer text <text>`
